KI-Assistenz für B2B-Kommunikation und S: AI assistance for B2B communication and social media strategy
Strategie, Content-Planung, Ausarbeitung: Strategy, content planning, drafting and ongoing communication work
AlthallerAssist ist laut Produktseite ei: According to its product page, AlthallerAssist is a proprietary digital offering from Althaller Communication – Gesellschaft für Marktkommunikation mbH. The AI assistant supports B2B teams with social media strategy, channel prioritisation, draft content, campaign ideas and management briefs. Study benchmarks by industry and company size inform budget, resource and KPI planning. The provider also describes adaptation to company context and an inspectable, editable memory feature. Users access the service in a browser on desktop and smartphones; the advertised entry price on 8 October 2026 is EUR 59 per month. Statements about a specialised language model, German hosting and data protection come from the provider; technical implementation has not been independently verified. The original page evidences conceptual and editorial support and benchmark analysis, without establishing operations for social listening, campaign tracking or direct post publication. The product page is undated; the catalogue intake date is not a publication date.
